title: Structured research state file
prompt: Research this topic and deliver a cited report: Impact of AI on creative industries. Organise all findings under the sector taxonomy you discover and keep that taxonomy in the research state.
config_change: Add `save_research_state` and `load_research_state` MCP tools; the coordinator must save the taxonomy and source map after research and load it right before building the synthesis packet.

rubric.check: research_state.json holds a taxonomy with >=3 sectors and a source map
synthesis packet contains the taxonomy sector names
